novelty_basis: Values for n <= 49 are published (Baird-Smith et al., arXiv:1809.04881, Fig. 4); optimality of the strategy for all n is Cusenza et al. 2022, Thm 1.2. Our computation is an independent check.
proof_check: computer-assisted - exhaustive longest-path dynamic programming over all reachable configurations (no strategy assumed), cross-checked against two independent greedy implementations and the earlier values n <= 60
statement: The longest game lengths L(n) for n <= 150 are those listed in results/EXP-C19-01.json (0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11, ...); for every n <= 150 the split-first strategy of Cusenza et al. attains them.
title: Exact longest games for n <= 150 and independent confirmation of the split-first strategy
